Add a licence-name gate with an allowlist (#287)

Add tools/check-licence-names.py, its allowlist
tools/licence-names-allowlist.tsv and its tests
tools/test-check-licence-names.py. The gate lists the tracked files
with git ls-files, reads each from the work tree, splits it at line
feeds only and finds every line that holds 1 of its 3 search terms in
any ASCII letter case; its docstring names the terms. It fails on such
a line that no allowlist row claims, on a line that the markers of 2
rows claim, on a row whose count is lower or higher than the number of
lines it claims, and on a malformed row, which includes a count that
is not canonical ASCII decimal and a row that repeats the path and
marker of an earlier row, malformed or not. It compares a count as
text, so a count of any length gives a named problem. It also fails,
naming the cause, when git ls-files fails or lists nothing, on an
unmerged index entry, on a tracked symbolic link or submodule, and on
a tracked file or allowlist that it cannot read. It runs git with a
fixed argument list and no shell and treats file content as data. In
each path, count, owner, marker and message that it shows, it writes a
character outside printable ASCII once as a backslash escape. Its own
3 files are its named exceptions; each must be tracked and must hold a
matching line. The allowlist has 1 row per kind of line in a file:
path, count, owner and marker. The gate refuses an owner other than
unit-2, unit-3 or keep; whether a row's owner is the right one is
reviewed prose that the gate does not check.

The tests build throwaway git repositories. Each refusal case first
runs the gate on the unchanged repository, which must pass, then makes
1 change and requires exit 1, exactly 1 summary line on standard
output, and problem lines that are exactly the cause and any
consequence that the case names with its reason. No run may write a
character outside printable ASCII. 3 cases load the gate in a separate
process and call its file reader with os.lstat or os.fdopen replaced,
to reach a descriptor that is not a regular file, a symbolic link that
appears after the lstat check, and a read error.

The Agent Plugins manifest workflow runs the tests and the gate as 2
new steps, and tools/run_all_checks.sh runs them as 2 new run lines.
tools/test-run-all-checks.py records the new digest of that script.
.github/squash/287.txt holds this message.

Checks a reviewer can rerun from the repository root, with their
expected outcomes:

    python3 -I tools/check-licence-names.py

exits 0, and at the head of this change its last line is
"check-licence-names: checked: 59 lines in 35 files; 0 problem(s)".

    python3 -I tools/check-licence-names.py --list

exits 0 and prints 1 line of path and count per file, then the line
"total: 59 lines in 35 files".

    python3 -I tools/test-check-licence-names.py
    python3 -I tools/test-run-all-checks.py

each exit 0.
